title: Product fundamentals quick check
description: A fast, timed check of the Ditto product basics — four products, one platform.

questions.prompt: Ditto Intelligence is a product a customer buys on its own, separate from Verify, Authenticate and Protect.
questions.explanation: Ditto Intelligence is the shared data layer underneath the other products, not a standalone purchase.

questions.prompt: Which product is the right fit for a customer asking: "how do we stop the same fraudster opening a new account after we've already banned them?"
questions.explanation: Ditto Protect is built around fraud and risk signals, including repeat-offender detection across accounts.

questions.prompt: Put these steps of a typical Ditto Verify check in the order they happen.

items.label: Document data is extracted and checked for signs of tampering
A selfie is matched against the document photo
A pass/fail result is returned to the customer's system

questions.explanation: Capture, then document checks, then biometric match, then result — each step can fail independently.

questions.prompt: How confident do you feel explaining the difference between the four Ditto products to a customer right now?
